answers.core: Because when on core, it could be optimized to better performance than creating a script to do it. As well it would help to beginners to create a 3D game with 2D physics without needing extra scripts just for this 2D/3D physics interaction.
answers.workaround: That would require a manual transformation synchronization between a RigidBody and a RigidBody2D, for example, as well could easilly mess with the scene organization, with a bunch of 2D nodes mixed with Spatial nodes.
